exam: What is the first step in the work‑up of a young woman with new‑onset psychosis and seizures? — Obtain CSF anti‑NMDA receptor antibodies and screen for ovarian teratoma; start high‑dose steroids promptly.
How would you differentiate NMDAR encephalitis from HSV encephalitis on EEG? — HSV shows focal temporal spikes; NMDAR shows diffuse slowing or extreme delta brush.
Why is plasma exchange preferred over steroids alone in severe cases? — It removes circulating antibodies rapidly, improving neurological recovery.
What is the significance of a normal brain MRI in suspected autoimmune encephalitis? — It does not exclude the diagnosis; MRI is often normal or non‑specific.
Which tumour marker would you check in a female patient with suspected NMDAR encephalitis? — CA‑125 and AFP to screen for ovarian teratoma.
Why should you avoid benzodiazepines in patients with autonomic instability? — They can worsen hypotension and mask seizures; use antiepileptics instead.
What is the role of rituximab in refractory NMDAR encephalitis? — It depletes B cells, reducing antibody production when steroids and IVIG fail.
ai.title: Autoimmune Encephalitis: NMDAR Antibody Encephalitis
ai.subject: Medicine
ai.summary: A rare but treatable brain inflammation caused by antibodies against the NMDA receptor. Presents with psychiatric, cognitive, and neurological symptoms, often in young women or children. Early recognition and immunotherapy improve outcomes.

sections.p: Autoimmune encephalitis is an immune‑mediated inflammation of the brain. The most common subtype is anti‑NMDA receptor encephalitis, where antibodies target the NR1 subunit of the NMDA receptor, disrupting glutamatergic neurotransmission.

sections.p: The disease follows a characteristic sequence: psychiatric onset, seizures, dyskinesias, autonomic instability, and hypoventilation. Early treatment with immunotherapy and tumour removal (if present) is critical.

sections.p: In low‑resource settings, the presentation may mimic viral encephalitis, HIV neurotoxicity, or drug toxicity. Rapid differentiation is essential to avoid unnecessary antibiotics and to start immunotherapy.
